description: Prove algorithm complexity — clearly thinker tier
system_prompt: You are an algorithms expert. Provide rigorous proofs.
user_message: Prove that the amortized time complexity of N insertions into a dynamic array (doubling strategy) is O(N) total, O(1) amortized per insertion. Use the potential method. Then explain why a 1.5x growth factor achieves the same asymptotic complexity but may be preferable in practice.
